items.item: The header shows the delivery note number, issue date, source sales order or transfer number and dispatching warehouse, each with a visible label, and every date on the note uses one unambiguous format (such as 06 Nov 2026)
items.evidence: Identity block (lines 73-81) has labelled Number/Order ref./Issue date/Delivery date, but 'Dispatch warehouse' only appears later in the separate 'Shipment details' section, not the header. More decisively, dates are rendered as '07/11/2026' and '09/11/2026' (ambiguous DD/MM vs MM/DD numeric slash format), not an unambiguous format like '06 Nov 2026'.

items.item: Sender (company name, address, tax ID), recipient (customer name, delivery address, contact person and phone) and carrier (carrier name, vehicle plate or driver name) appear in three separately labelled blocks
items.evidence: Recipient is clearly labelled ('Customer' / 'Deliver to' under h2 'Parties'). Carrier data (Carrier, Vehicle plate, Driver) is present but merged into the 'Shipment details' block alongside unrelated Incoterms/Freight fields rather than its own labelled block. The sender block (Harborline Distribution Co., address, Tax ID at lines 67-72) has no heading/label at all (e.g. 'Sender' or 'Shipped from') — it is just unlabelled text above the title.

items.item: The goods are in a real <table> with column headers in <thead>, giving per line: line number, item code, description, unit of measure, quantity ordered, quantity delivered and lot or serial number, with quantities right-aligned
items.evidence: `<table id="goodsTable">` with `<thead>` columns No./SKU/Description/Unit/Qty ordered/Qty shipped/Notes (lines 122-132); qty cells use `text-right tabular-nums`. However there is no lot or serial number column — the last column is a free-text 'Notes' field ('—', '2 back-ordered'), not a lot/serial identifier.

items.item: A line delivered short of the ordered quantity states the outstanding amount in words (such as "Backorder: 4 pcs")
items.evidence: Row for PKG-20045 (qtyOrdered 30, qtyShipped 28) shows Notes text '2 back-ordered' (script line 203), a textual statement of the shortfall, not a colour-only indicator.

items.item: A footer gives the total quantity delivered, the number of packages and the gross weight with its unit, and the quantity total equals the sum of the lines
items.evidence: `<tfoot>` totals Qty ordered=117 and Qty shipped=115 (#totalOrdered/#totalShipped), which correctly equal the sum of the six lines (20+40+15+28+2+10=115). But the only package/weight mention is the line '6 line items · 115 units shipped on 6 pallets' (#packageSummary) — there is no gross weight or weight unit anywhere on the note.

items.item: Signature boxes are provided for the warehouse keeper (issued by), the driver or carrier and the receiver, each with room for printed name, signature and date, plus a remarks area for the condition of the goods on receipt
items.evidence: Three `.sig-block` divs: 'Issued by — Harborline Distribution', 'Carrier / Driver', 'Received by — Customer' (lines 161-187), each with a `.sig-box`, 'Name: ____' and 'Date: ____' lines; the receiver block adds 'Condition on receipt: ☐ Good ☐ Damaged ☐ Shortage'.

items.item: A Print control that is a real <button> starts printing, and an @media print stylesheet hides the app navigation and on-screen controls, sets page margins and keeps the signature block from splitting across pages
items.evidence: `<button type="button" id="printBtn">Print</button>` wired to `printDocument()` → `window.print()` (lines 54-56, 232-236). `@media print` hides `.no-print` (the screen header with breadcrumb/buttons), `@page { size: A4; margin: 14mm 12mm 16mm; }` sets margins, and `.sig-block { break-inside: avoid; }` keeps signatures from splitting.

items.item: The note's status (such as Draft, Dispatched, Delivered or Cancelled) is shown in words next to its number, and a draft or cancelled note prints with a visible "DRAFT" or "CANCELLED" mark
items.evidence: Status pill 'In transit' sits next to the H1 number on screen (line 48), but it lives inside `<header class="no-print">`, which is hidden by `@media print { .no-print { display: none !important; } }` — so no status appears on the printed document at all. There is also no script logic that renders a DRAFT/CANCELLED watermark for those states; status is a static hardcoded string.

items.item: A loading state is present, and a note that fails to load or does not exist shows a message with Retry and a link back to the delivery note list, never an empty template with blank fields
items.evidence: The script (lines 198-237) only renders a hardcoded `goods` array synchronously; there is no loading indicator, no fetch/error branch, and no Retry control or 'back to list' link anywhere in the markup or script.

notes: No classic template tells (greeting-header, kpi-icon-tiles, gradient, glass, emoji-icon, rainbow-status, sidebar-promo-card, decorative-chart, hover-lift, oversized-radius, navy-sidebar-indigo-accent, etc.) were observed — the page is a plain, print-oriented document layout. Minor audit-only issues not in the checklist: the line-number column isn't right-aligned/tabular, phone numbers aren't tel: links, and the sheet uses a drop shadow instead of a pure border (audit.json rules numeric-align, contact-link, surface-shadow).
